senses.gloss:
भाज् a. partaking of, entitled to, connected with, belonging
to, sharing, enjoying, practising, occupying, inhabiting, revering (—˚,
r. gen.).

भजन n. adoration, worship;
 ˚ता f. the same.

भा॑जन n. vessel, dish, receptacle i.e. fit place or
person for (gen. or —˚, cf. पा॑त्र), substitute;
 adj. —˚ sharing,
partaking of, relating or belonging to, serving or equivalent for.
भजनीय a. to be loved or adored.
भाजिन् a. partaking of, connected with (—˚).
भाज्य a. to be distributed or divided.
